sourceTexts.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאוֹר כִּי טוֹב וַיַּבְדֵּל אֱלֹהִים בֵּין הָאוֹר וּבֵין הַחֹשֶׁךְ
sourceTexts.aramaic: וַחֲזָא יְיָ יָת נְהוֹרָא אֲרֵי טָב וְאַפְרֵישׁ יְיָ בֵּין נְהוֹרָא וּבֵין חֲשׁוֹכָא
sourceTexts.greek: καὶ εἶδεν ὁ θεὸς τὸ φῶς ὅτι καλόν καὶ διεχώρισεν ὁ θεὸς ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ φωτὸς καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ σκότους

literalTranslations.pt: E viu Deus a luz, que era boa; e fez separação Deus entre a luz e as trevas.
literalTranslations.en: And God saw the light, that it was good; and God separated between the light and the darkness.

hebrewWitnesses.label: Codex Leningradensis (B19A)
hebrewWitnesses.text: וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאוֹר כִּי טוֹב וַיַּבְדֵּל אֱלֹהִים בֵּין הָאוֹר וּבֵין הַחֹשֶׁךְ
hebrewWitnesses.transliteration: Vayar Elohim et haor ki tov vayavdel Elohim bein haor uvein hachoshek
hebrewWitnesses.literalPt: E viu Deus a luz, que era boa; e fez separação Deus entre a luz e as trevas.
hebrewWitnesses.literalEn: And God saw the light, that it was good; and God separated between the light and the darkness.

hebrewWitnesses.text: וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאוֹר כִּי טוֹב וַיַּבְדֵּל אֱלֹהִים בֵּין הָאוֹר וּבֵין הַחֹשֶׁךְ

hebrewWitnesses.literalPt: E viu Deus a luz, que era boa; e fez separação Deus entre a luz e as trevas.
hebrewWitnesses.literalEn: And God saw the light, that it was good; and God separated between the light and the darkness.

aramaicWitnesses.label: Targum Onkelos
aramaicWitnesses.text: וַחֲזָא יְיָ יָת נְהוֹרָא אֲרֵי טָב וְאַפְרֵישׁ יְיָ בֵּין נְהוֹרָא וּבֵין חֲשׁוֹכָא
aramaicWitnesses.transliteration: Vachaza YY yat nehora arei tav ve-afreish YY bein nehora uvein chashokha
aramaicWitnesses.literalPt: E viu o Senhor a luz, que era boa; e o Senhor separou entre a luz e as trevas.
aramaicWitnesses.literalEn: And the Lord saw the light, that it was good; and the Lord separated between the light and the darkness.

greekWitnesses.label: Septuaginta (LXX)
greekWitnesses.text: καὶ εἶδεν ὁ θεὸς τὸ φῶς ὅτι καλόν καὶ διεχώρισεν ὁ θεὸς ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ φωτὸς καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ σκότους
greekWitnesses.transliteration: kai eiden ho theos to phōs hoti kalon kai diechōrisen ho theos ana meson tou phōtos kai ana meson tou skotous
greekWitnesses.literalPt: E viu Deus a luz que era boa, e separou Deus a luz das trevas.
greekWitnesses.literalEn: And God saw the light that it was good, and God divided the light from the darkness.
